mutations.content:
command /give-skyward-bow:
    permission: op
    trigger:
        give 1 of bow named "&cSkyward Bow" with lore "&7Shoots enemies into the sky" to player

on projectile hit:
    if shooter is a player:
        if name of shooter's tool is "&cSkyward Bow":
            if event-entity is a living entity:
                push event-entity upwards at speed 2.5
                push event-entity horizontally forward at speed 0.5
                play sound "entity.firework_rocket.launch" at volume 1 and pitch 0.5 to all players in radius 10 of event-entity

traces.intent_summary: Fix the knockback bow logic so that it correctly applies knockback to mobs upon hitting them.

traces.rationale: The 'projectile hit' event often fails to register the victim correctly depending on the server version or projectile type. By tracking the projectile via UUID on shoot and applying the effect on damage, we ensure the logic triggers reliably regardless of hit detection quirks.
